protocol: One pass per release, same 18 Chinese requests via POST /reports/{id}/questions, rag mode, no manual facts, new independent company. For 14 lookup questions require initial top-5 exact labelled line at designated physical page, exact amount in USD millions, requested fiscal year, explicit unit and page in answer. Refusals require explicit unavailability with no numeric answer other than the requested year. This is a document holdout, not evidence that the model never saw the report in training. Later replays are regression checks.
instruction: 请只给目标年度、金额（以百万美元为单位）和 PDF 物理页码。如果这份报告没有披露该年度实际金额，请只回答“未披露”。
